title: LLM isolation X8: every flow-steering output is a declared JSON file that a phasecontract schema checks
summary: The advisor, plan judge and retry adjudicator take the last JSON span of stdout (go/internal/core/advisor/parse.go:34,60; phase_judge.go:84; retry_adjudicator_agent.go:70), the failure advisor parses lines (failure_advisor.go:149,165), and the router digest and triage capacity fall back to prose (go/internal/router/digest.go:284,333,345; go/internal/triagecap/floors.go:31,101). Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §12.
fix: Each flow seat writes advisor-decision.json, judge-verdict.json, retry-adjudication.json, failure-advice.json or triage-decision.json, with a phasecontract schema. Stage legacy for one wave: read the file first, fall back to stdout, emit ISOLATION_I8_VIOLATION on each fallback. Stage enforce: remove the span parsers and prose fallbacks.
acceptance: RED first: row N12 (a judge verdict in prose with no file passes) fails before and passes after
A schema test for each decision file rejects an unknown field and a missing field
In legacy each fallback emits ISOLATION_I8_VIOLATION
At enforce no flow decision reads stdout; a grep guard pins LastBalancedSpan out of flow code
Changed functions at 100% coverage; spec §12 and the core and router package notes updated
